rows.en: ＊Command＊＠１５２＿０１８Make sure everything is in place￥so the candidates can train￥efficiently every day.
＊Command＊＠１５２＿０２０They carry the future of￥all humanity on their￥shoulders, after all...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０２１Command sure is diligent...＝＠１５２＿０２２Now that these calls￥come in so often...＝＠１５２＿０２３I think I get the pressure the￥candidates are under.＝＠１５２＿０２４It's hard on those kids, too...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０２５Huh?￥Oh, h-how long have you￥been there?＝＠１５２＿０２６Don't tell me... you heard￥all that just now...?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０２８I see... Lying isn't good.＝＠１５２＿０２９If you overheard, I'd rather￥you just be honest about it.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０３０Go back to your room for today.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿００１Lately, Command has been￥contacting us supervisors￥very often.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿００２And every time, I can see￥the responsibility and hopes￥they've placed on you all...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿００４I wonder if all those voices￥are weighing on you all...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿００５I see. That's certainly one way￥to look at it.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿００６It seems I was trying to fit￥all of you into my own way￥of thinking.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿００７I'm sorry for burdening you￥with all this...
Ease up on us a little.
Ease up on us a little.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿００８Thank you.￥Hearing that takes a load off.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０１０But you also need to get￥stronger yourself.＝＠１５３＿０１１Once you qualify, you'll face￥even more mental and physical￥pressure.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０１２In the end,￥you'll have to overcome￥all of it...＝＠１５３＿０１３So stay strong!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０１４Truth is, I've always dreamed￥of going to Elan myself.＝＠１５３＿０１５So watching all the candidates,￥I was a little envious.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０１６But you know...＝＠１５３＿０１７Bit by bit, I've come to see how￥heavy those hopes are, and how￥scary an unknown planet is...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０１８Well... let me see...＝＠１５３＿０１９The more I learned about that￥unknown planet, and going there,￥the more "fear" I felt.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０２１But hearing it from a candidate￥doesn't feel very nice.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０２２I had my own reasons for￥changing my mind.＝＠１５３＿０２３Well, I'll get back to work.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０２４What about you?￥Don't you ever feel￥that kind of "fear"?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０２５Silly question, huh? Somehow you￥don't look worried at all!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０２６You're fearless, aren't you?￥That's refreshing!＝＠１５３＿０２７Seems I worried for nothing.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５３＿０２８You can bounce back from￥any pressure, I'm sure.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿００１Talking with you has somehow￥cheered me up.＝＠１５４＿００２It's like you shared some of￥your energy with me.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿００３Oh, I've been chatting too long.￥And I'm still on the clock.￥See you!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿００４Oh, and from now on,￥no more eavesdropping.
